from sklearn.gaussian_process import GaussianProcessRegressor
from sklearn.gaussian_process.kernels import RBF,ConstantKernel,WhiteKernel
D=json.load(open('evaluations.json')); names=[r['ingredient'] for r in D[0]['recipe']]; X=np.array([[next((r['fraction'] for r in d['recipe'] if r['ingredient']==n),0) for n in names] for d in D]); y=np.array([d['target_dissimilarity'] for d in D]); print(names)
# scale by meaningful step sizes
s=np.array([.03,.02,.015,.015,.008,.004,.003,.002,.002]); Z=X/s
k=ConstantKernel(.02,(.001,1))*RBF(1,(.1,10))+WhiteKernel(.005,(.0005,.03))
gp=GaussianProcessRegressor(kernel=k,normalize_y=False,n_restarts_optimizer=10).fit(Z,y); print(gp.kernel_)
rng=np.random.default_rng(42); base=X[1]; C=np.tile(base,(50000,1)); C[:,1:]=np.maximum(C[:,1:]+rng.normal(size=(len(C),8))*s[1:]*.45, .0001); C[:,0]=1-C[:,1:].sum(1); mu,std=gp.predict(C/s,return_std=True); inds=np.argsort(mu-.3*std)[:5]; print([(dict(zip(names,C[i])),mu[i],std[i]) for i in inds]); np.savez('suggestions.npz',C=C,mu=mu,std=std)
"}
